Fold Test.

Fold a sheet of tracing paper until its shape and ink match the target.

Your sheet

Fold from

How to play

Choose a side and how many rows or columns to fold in. The tinted area is your flap. It flips inward across the dashed crease. Ink on every layer stays visible.

Match the target’s size and the marks in each square. If you overshoot, undo or reset as often as you like. Every button works with touch or Tab and Enter. Your solved puzzles stay in this browser.

No timer. No sound. Just paper.
